# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 10 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve Becomes Pregnant with Cain

---

**1** Adam and Eve entered paradise again, and God appeared to them in a cloud of light.

**2** God said to Adam: 'I told you that you are of the earth and you shall return to the earth. But I will raise you up again from the earth on the last day. Then I will give you all things.'

**3** Eve conceived and bore Cain, and at his birth he was bright and shining.

**4** Adam took Eve and the child and led them to the east of paradise.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
